title: Why do I have to brush them two times?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: It's time to brush your teeth now.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Why do I have to brush them two times?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: You brush once in the morning and once at night.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: But nothing bad happened to them today.

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: That's exactly the point — we want to keep them that way.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: And why do I have to use the toothpaste too?

dialogue.speaker: Dad
dialogue.line: Because it scrubs your teeth much better than water.

dialogue.speaker: Child
dialogue.line: Okay, I will do it, but I'm counting fast.

variations: "brush twice" 换 "go to bed now"；"toothpaste" 换 "the foam one"。
